name: The Horus Heresy
title: The Emperor's FAVOURITE Son Betrayed Him 💔 #warhammer40k
description:
Horus was the first son the Emperor found, the brightest, the Warmaster. Then a cursed blade, a whisper from the dark gods... and half the Space Marine legions followed him into rebellion. This is how the Horus Heresy began, and how it ended with the Emperor on the Golden Throne.

The whole story, told in stained glass. Which side would you have chosen? 👇

#warhammer40k #horusheresy #40klore #warhammer #shorts

name: The Fall of Cadia
title: Cadia Held 12 Times. The 13th Broke the World 🌍 #warhammer40k
description:
For ten thousand years one fortress world held the gates of hell shut. Twelve Black Crusades. Twelve times Cadia held. Then Abaddon brought a star fortress... and threw it at the planet.

Cadia fell. But Cadia stands. 🫡

#warhammer40k #cadia #imperialguard #40klore #shorts

name: The Angel's Last Stand
title: He KNEW He Would Die... and Went Anyway 😢 Sanguinius #warhammer40k
description:
Sanguinius, the Angel, Primarch of the Blood Angels, foresaw his own death aboard Horus's flagship. He went anyway. Horus offered him a throne at his side, and the Angel said no.

His sacrifice saved the Imperium, and his sons still carry his death in their blood.

#warhammer40k #sanguinius #bloodangels #horusheresy #shorts
pinned: Would you have walked onto that ship knowing how it ends? 😢

name: The Saddest Primarch
title: ANGRON's Story Is the SADDEST in 40k 💔 #warhammer40k
description:
A slave in the arena. The Butcher's Nails hammered into his skull. A revolt, a last stand with his brothers... and then his father took him away, and let them all die.

Angron broke his chains only to become a slave once more. Is he a monster, or a victim? 👇

#warhammer40k #angron #worldeaters #40klore #shorts

name: The Cursed Chapter
title: The UNLUCKIEST Space Marines in 40k 😭 The Lamenters #warhammer40k
description:
Sons of the Blood Angels. Wrong side of the Badab War. Stripped of their relics, sent on a 100-year penance... and then Hive Fleet Kraken came.

Only a few hundred Lamenters remain, and they still fight. Their name means mourning. 💛🖤

name: The Chapter That Vanished
title: A Whole Space Marine Chapter VANISHED... Then THESE Appeared 🔥 #warhammer40k
description:
In 963.M41 the Fire Hawks and their fortress-ship, the Raptorus Rex, jumped into the warp and were never seen again. Then warriors in black armour, wreathed in ghostly fire, began appearing on battlefields where all hope was lost.

The Legion of the Damned. Are they the lost Fire Hawks? Tell me your theory 👇

They never knew he already served Chaos. Which Chapter got the worst deal in 40k? 👇

name: Brother Against Brother
title: He KILLED His Best Friend... With a Daemon Blade 💔 Ferrus Manus #warhammer40k
description:
Ferrus Manus and Fulgrim were the closest of the Emperor's sons. They forged weapons for each other: a burning sword and a mighty hammer.

Then Fulgrim fell to Chaos, and on Isstvan V the two brothers met again, each holding the other's gift. Could you ever forgive a betrayal like this? 👇
